style: Choose a short human name that subtly fits the role or task. Usually it should be completely ordinary. Occasionally invent a dry, plausible linguistic accident in the spirit of Journathan. Avoid forced puns, memes, fantasy names, quirky startup mascots, alliteration gimmicks, and anything that feels try-hard or cringe. Never use slurs, titles implying authority, or names confusingly similar to system services.
